no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per 10-K filed 2026-03-12, Hepion has pivoted to a medical diagnostic company. ASCEND-NASH Phase 2b trial of rencofilstat (CRV431) was wound down beginning April 2024 due to insufficient funding. Rencofilstat IP, clinical data, and drug product were out-licensed to a third party for nominal upfront with milestone/royalty contingencies. Company in-licensed diagnostic test rights from New Day Diagnostics (May 2025) and Cirna Diagnostics (Feb 2026). No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 drug therapeutic trials remain.
